headline: Juan, a finance and investment commentator, on fuel prices: "There has never been such a difference between the price of oil and diesel"
summary: Crude is falling sharply, but diesel bills keep rising due to taxes, lower refining capacity and higher maritime transport costs, according to a finance commentator.
why: Diesel prices depend on crude costs plus refining margins, taxes and shipping, so the two can diverge when refining capacity or freight costs change.
